notes: The transmitter power values include typical and worst-case values with and without TX shaping as printed under Max Transmit Power. Symbol rates printed as raw baud counts were not converted to GBaud; only explicitly stated approximate GBaud values were extracted. Extended RX sensitivity values are specified at a 1dB OSNR penalty, but no supported penalty object was created because an operating condition from the schema's condition enumeration was not stated. Multichannel OSNR penalties are stated for adjacent-channel spacing or crosstalk conditions, which are not available condition parameters in the penalty schema. The normal operating case temperature is 15 to +75°C. +80°C is a short-term operating case temperature, and -5°C is only the minimum ambient cold-start temperature.
suggestions: Add fields for exact symbol rate in baud, typical versus worst-case transmitter power, TX-shaping state, extended RX sensitivity at OSNR penalty, state-of-polarization change rate, multichannel crosstalk tolerance, adjacent-channel spacing conditions, short-term temperature limits, and per-model/per-modulation parameter association.
